text.p: Tenet Healthcare Corp said Monday it upped payment to note holders who consent to proposed amendments to indentures governing its $1.7 billion in notes issued in 1995.

A Tenet spokesman said the company increased to $3.00 from $1.125 its payment for each $1,000 to each holder who delivers and does not revoke a consent to the proposed amendments prior to the consent period expiration on August 21.

The hospital operator said it revised the terms for its previously announced consent sollicitation for proposed amendments to the indentures governing its 9.625 percent senior notes due 2002, 8.625 percent senior notes due 2003 and 10.125 percent senior subordinated notes due 2005.
